query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('albums',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)),'[]') FROM albums a WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL),'photos',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)),'[]') FROM photos p WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL),'originals',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)),'[]') FROM original_trash t)) AS "page!"
